candidate.rationale: Restore slice-bounds handling: reject interior surrogate-pair start offsets and move an interior end backward before the pair so reads never split a pair, per cases.json requirements.

Replace serialized-string comparison with structural isDeepStrictEqual comparison, preserving order-insensitivity for object members while keeping array order/types significant and the response_not_text/invalid_json reasons unchanged.

Fix retention-tool-pairs mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and require each tool result's tool_call_id to match the assistant call at the same positional index (instead of mere set membership), per inspected cases 13-15; masking behavior unchanged.

Repair retention-tool-pair validation per contract: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange, and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (ordered one-to-one pairing) instead of mere membership. Masking behavior and export unchanged.

Fix failing empty-history check: a recentCount larger than history.length (e.g. recentCount=1 with an empty history) is valid and yields an empty projection, so the upper-bound check recentCount <= history.length is removed. All other behavior — tool-call/result one-to-one positional pairing, call-ID uniqueness and non-emptiness, masking of entries older than the recent window — is preserved, satisfying the pair-0..7 checks.

Repair retention-tool-pairs mutation: require positional one-to-one matching of each tool result to the assistant call at the same index (not mere membership) and require call IDs to be unique within each exchange, per cases-09/10/13/14 while preserving export and unrelated behavior.

Replace stringified-JSON comparison with isDeepStrictEqual so parsed JSON is compared structurally (nested values, member order ignored, array order/types/missing/extra members significant). Preserved exports and response_not_text / invalid_json reasons. No tests were run.
Restore archive-slice-bounds behavior: reject an offset that starts inside a surrogate pair, and move an interior end backward before the pair; keep validation, exports, and return fields unchanged.

Repair archive-slice-bounds: define the previously missing splitPair helper (backs an interior end off a surrogate pair), and reject an interior start on a low surrogate. end-boundary: "xy😀z",0,3 backs end 3→2 returning "xy"; no-progress: "😀",0,1 backs end 1→0 and errors; start-boundary: offset 3 on a low surrogate errors. Exports and unrelated behavior preserved.

Restore structural JSON equality: JSON.stringify comparison failed on reordered object keys. Use isDeepStrictEqual on parsed values, which ignores object key order but preserves array order, types, and missing/extra members. Keep response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and existing export unchanged.

Fix controlled retention-tool-pairs mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (not mere membership), preserving exports and unrelated behavior.

Repair retention tool-pair validation per evidence/cases.json requirements: call IDs must be unique within each exchange and each tool result must match the assistant call at the same positional index (membership alone is insufficient). Added a uniqueness check on ids and replaced the ids.includes(message.tool_call_id) membership test with positional equality ids[index]; masking of old content and the recent-window boundary are unchanged.
